machine: Flash (Vinay's Ubuntu box, ssh flash, 12 threads, qwen-test venv: python 3.14 + numpy 2.5.4 + tokenizers 0.23.3)

model_pair.local_note: downloaded directly on Flash from Hugging Face (public, non-gated repos; byte sizes verified against the HF API listing: base 15,242,788,009 B, instruct 15,242,788,168 B). The original plan was to download on the Muse VM and copy over; that was dropped after measuring the VM egress at about 2.7 MB/s against about 21 MB/s on Flash. This pair is the 7B scale test requested Oct 28 after the fresh-eyes review asked whether the results survive above 1B parameters
model_pair.matrices: embedding + lm_head (separate: embeddings are NOT tied on Qwen2.5-7B) + 28 blocks x (attn.q/k/v/o_proj, mlp.gate/up/down_proj) = 198 delta matrices

probe_set.source: the combined 96 fresh Spark probe items from Phase 1 (data/heldout_probes_spark.json's original 24 held-out + data/heldout72_probes_spark.json's 72 expansion items, combined by this script with Phase 1's subset tags); no pair's sweep saw them during search, Stage 1, or Stage 2

generation.note: winner already fits the uniform budget; no byte-matched variant needed

price_validation.method: factored.storage_bytes summed over the 198 real matrices read from the model files, computed in the Flash build pass (same code path as Stage 2 pricing)

method.configs: base (no delta), full_delta (Instruct weights), factored_delta per recipe (uniform_rank32, the Stage 2 winner, the byte-matched variant), and the plain 1-bit BitDelta-style init baseline
method.scoring: identical to fifth_pair Stage 2: ChatML chat prompt (system line 'You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.'); target logprob = summed log-probability of the answer tokens; accuracy = first-token accuracy; gap_closed = (factored - base) / (full - base) on mean target logprob, per subset with that subset's own base/full references
method.forward_pass: the fifth_pair_stage2 streamed NumPy Qwen2.5 forward (AirLLM-style block streaming), validated in Stage 2 by internal consistency (graft check, quantize_delta cross-check, full-delta-beats-base gap)

gap_closed_note: one or more factored configs outscore the full fp16 delta itself on the combined 96, so gap_closed passes 1.0 and is NOT a recovery fraction for this pair (Glimmer wording limit, Oct 27); the raw mean target logprob margin is the honest measure

baseline_plain_1bit.name: bitdelta_init
baseline_plain_1bit.label: BitDelta-style initialization only (sign(delta) x per-matrix mean|delta|); NO scale distillation or training of any kind
baseline_plain_1bit.price_basis: ceil(params/8) + 4 bytes (one fp32 scale) per matrix, summed over the 198 recipe matrices on the real shapes; this is the plain 1-bit floor price for this pair
baseline_plain_1bit.factored_at_same_budget_note: not run at 7B in this pass; the factored configs above sit at the uniform rank-32 budget, far below this floor

verdict.byte_fair_headline_question: does down_king beat uniform_rank32 on the combined 96 fresh items?
